sourceFinding.aiClaim: Tax Amount valid value range is 1-9999999.
sourceFinding.assessment: The stated range matches ATL105's Element 99 valid-values range. It omits the numeric type and two assumed decimal places. The source permits eight bytes for American Express and seven bytes for other card types, but the valid-value ceiling itself remains 9999999.
sourceFinding.distinction: Element 99 Tax Amount is distinct from Element 74 PC Tax Amount.

independentTestAssessment.existingRuleScope: Total tax amount semantics; not an Element 99 value-range rule.
independentTestAssessment.candidateDesign: One scenario with inclusive minimum/maximum and out-of-range boundary vectors; no tax calculation or execution is claimed.

aiCaseReview.conclusion: All six frozen candidate payload observations declare Segment 100 Element 99 omitted. None demonstrates the correct range, numeric type, assumed-decimal representation, or the total-tax semantic rule.

adjudicationGaps: Confirm tax applicability and currency context for complete Segment 100 fixtures. ATL105 notes sales tax applies to EBT Cash Benefits only and not EBT Food Stamps.
Confirm the serialized meaning of the minimum value under the two assumed decimal places.
Keep Element 99 total tax semantics and Element 74 PC Tax Amount independent from this range oracle.
Review complete fixtures and expected outcomes with the authorized Test owner before promotion or execution.
